answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The system's strength comes from the fact that reputation is spent against performance, so a flood of accounts is filtered by the same economics that reward real work.. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. Consider a crystal as the anchor of the cost. A vine stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a vault...
